experiment: Claude + TypeSafe Jev clean-room prospective test, Jamaica Lotto #2340
written_before: any walk-forward, number-discovery or ticket-construction result was computed
dataset: data/04_normalized_analysis_dataset.csv (169 draws: 2161-2339, missing 2252-2261 left as a documented gap)

gap_handling.sequence: Analyses use the observed draw sequence in chronological order.
gap_handling.lag_features: Features that use the previous draw (repeat, transition) are only formed across consecutive draw IDs; a pair spanning the 2252-2261 gap contributes nothing.
gap_handling.gap_features: Appearance gaps are counted in observed draws; missing draws are not imputed.

walk_forward.targets: every draw at chronological index 29..168 (140 targets)
walk_forward.causality: For target t every feature, ranking, normalization, pair statistic, parameter choice, ensemble weight and ticket is computed from draws strictly before t, then frozen, then scored against draw t.
walk_forward.rolling_windows_when_short: windows use all available prior draws when fewer than the window length exist

number_rankers.H_random: uniform random ranking, seed MASTER_SEED + target index (mandatory control)
number_rankers.A_inv_cold: negative of A (tests the 'cold numbers' hypothesis rather than assuming it)
number_rankers.B_roll_W: count over last W draws, W in {10, 20, 30, 50, 100}
number_rankers.B_ew_h: exponentially weighted count with half-life h draws, h in {10, 20, 40}
number_rankers.C_recent: negative current gap (more recent ranks higher)
number_rankers.C_hazard: pooled empirical re-appearance hazard at each number's current gap, estimated from prior draws with Beta(6,32) smoothing
number_rankers.C_own_gap_pct: current gap percentile within that number's own prior gap distribution (higher ranks higher)
number_rankers.D_trend_20v40: rate in last 20 draws minus rate in the 40 draws before them
number_rankers.D_slope_50: least-squares slope of the appearance indicator over the last 50 draws
number_rankers.E_transition: mean smoothed lift P(i at s | j at s-1)/P(i) over j in the previous draw, estimated from prior consecutive draw pairs
number_rankers.E_pair_centrality: sum of positive smoothed co-occurrence z-lifts to all other numbers (pair network strength)
number_rankers.G_ensemble_equal: equal-weight average of percentile ranks of A_freq_all, B_ew_20, C_hazard, D_trend_20v40, E_transition
number_rankers.G_ensemble_adaptive: weights over the same five components proportional to max(0, trailing excess top-12 capture) over all earlier walk-forward targets; equal weights until 10 earlier targets exist

ticket_constructors.opt_top8/10/12/15: best 6-subset inside the ranker's top m by J = mean score z + lambda_pair * mean pair z-lift + lambda_struct * standardized log null-probability of the ticket's structure class; default lambda_pair=0.5, lambda_struct=0.5
ticket_constructors.pair_top12: 6-subset of top 12 maximizing mean pair z-lift (score as tie-break)
ticket_constructors.struct_top12: 6-subset of top 12 maximizing structure-class null probability (score as tie-break)
ticket_constructors.diversity_top15: greedy by score from top 15 with at most two numbers per band 1-10/11-20/21-30/31-38
ticket_constructors.consensus: six numbers with the highest count of appearances in the top-12 of the component rankers (A_freq_all, B_ew_20, C_hazard, D_trend_20v40, E_transition), ties by G_ensemble_equal
ticket_constructors.structure_class: (sum decile under the exact null, odd count, low(1-19) count, consecutive-pair count capped at 2)

sensitivity: lambda grid {0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0} x {0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0} for opt_top12, window and half-life grids for B, reported on both periods

endpoints.primary: mean matches of the 6-number ticket per target
secondary: top-k winner coverage for k in {6,8,10,12,15,20}
endpoints.null: Under an independent uniform draw process any causal ticket's matches at each target are exactly Hypergeometric(38,6,6), independent across targets; exact p-values use the convolution of those pmfs.

validated_edge_definition.step_1: Using development-period results only, select the single non-control ticket method with the highest development mean matches (ties: earlier in the method list).
validated_edge_definition.step_2: Test that one method on the confirmation period with the exact one-sided test (alternative: more matches than random). Required: p < 0.05.
validated_edge_definition.step_3: The same method family must also beat baseline on the confirmation period in at least two thirds of its sensitivity variants.
validated_edge_definition.step_4: No global randomness test contradicts the mechanism (reported, not required).
validated_edge_definition.validated: VALIDATED EDGE only if steps 2 and 3 both hold.
validated_edge_definition.suggestive: Confirmation p in [0.05, 0.10), or any method with raw p < 0.05 that does not survive Holm correction across the method family.
validated_edge_definition.number_discovery: The same dev-select / confirm procedure is applied to rankers for top-12 coverage, reported as secondary evidence.

family: pair co-occurrence dispersion and max pair count
randomness_tests.correction: Holm across the global family; Benjamini-Hochberg for per-number and per-pair tests
classification: suggestive but insufficient (raw p < 0.05, not surviving correction)
